# Some textures for Dark theme!
BMP Dark Theme is a resource pack created by the BMProjects team. Its purpose is to add in our modpacks some new textures that changed vanilla GUI. This need for more immersion in atmosphere of project!

## Mods Compability:
- Accessories
- AppleSkin
- Cosmetic Armor Reworked
- Crafting Tweaks
